make deploy runs its own npm ci, checks the Web3Forms key in .env (VITE_WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY), builds, then deploy.sh with the shared helper's live check.
make deploy = npm run deploy:ssh = build, then scripts/deploy-ssh.sh (assets first with --delete, then the tree; live check on the second rsync).
make deploy = npm run deploy = build, then scripts/deploy-ssh.sh in four phases with its own verify-production.mjs against https://ssatcy.com.

make deploy runs `check` (python3 tools, node, and an ssh preflight) then rsyncs the repo root with --delete. art-library.js is gitignored and generated (a 4 MB download), so a clean checkout lacks it and the rsync would delete it from the live site; it is copied from the owner's clone instead.
